# Rabin R

> Senior Frontend Angular Consultant in Chennai, India, with 4+ years building
> high-performance web and mobile products. Specialises in Angular (Zoneless +
> Signals), TypeScript, React and Next.js, with a track record on government and
> enterprise systems serving tens of thousands of users.

Contact: hello@rabinr.in — based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Available for
consulting and contract engagements.

## Selected work

- [Fiji Immigration Internal Management System](https://www.rabinr.in/work/fiji-immigration-internal): High-consequence government case management platform serving 10,000+ users, built with Angular and TypeScript.
- [Fiji Immigration Citizen Portal](https://www.rabinr.in/work/fiji-immigration-external): Public-facing citizen portal for the Fiji Government's Immigration Department.
- [PRIMS Member Portal](https://www.rabinr.in/work/prims-member-portal): Pension member portal covering account management and member services.
